data.narrative:
Addionics is a Series B climate and energy technology company that has raised $39M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of nine private and one public company operating in advanced energy storage, battery materials, and related frontier technologies. Primary peers include KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy, all at Series C stage with valuations ranging from $700M to $3.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($39M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $74M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range of $700M to $3.0B. The disparity reflects both the early-stage discount relative to later-stage peers and the wide performance variance in this sector.

Triangulating these two methods produces a range of $63M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $537M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while peer multiples drive the upper bound. Key uncertainties include technology maturity relative to comparable companies, capital intensity of next-stage development, and near-term financing conditions in climate tech. The wide range reflects genuine ambiguity around Addionics' commercial trajectory relative to the peer set.
